title: Service Advisor - B. Add inspection to a work order line
preconds: Logged in as Service Advisor. WO = View/Create&Edit (no WO Delete) but WOL = V/E/D -> full inspection rights follow the LINE (SV-8095). A work order with at least one line exists.
steps:
1. Log in.
  2. Open a work order and locate a line.
  3. Open the three-dot menu on the line.
  4. Select Add Inspection and choose a template.
expected:
Step 3: The three-dot menu shows Add Inspection.
Step 4: The inspection template is added and "Inspection added to line." is shown. (Gated by WOL Create and Edit - SV-8095 AC2.)
